Aggressive preset removes nav, footer, aside unconditionally

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert, ConversionOptions, PreprocessingOptions

def main() -> None:
    html = "<nav>Menu</nav><article><h1>Title</h1><p>Content</p></article><aside>Sidebar</aside><footer>Footer</footer>"
    options = ConversionOptions(preprocessing=PreprocessingOptions(preset=PreprocessingPreset("Aggressive")))
    result = convert(html, options)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
